g.text: Standard cc compile and run
Milliseconds; medians with observed min/max (not confidence intervals)
Gray: off Orange: isolated
Standard cc paired cost: +2591.1 ms median, +5524.8 ms worst; 7/7 slower.
Most standard-cc growth is inside the command. Cache/IPC causes are not separately proven.
230 rows include warmups; 93 evaluation pairs. Full raw pairs retain negative values and failures.
No model inference or real cloud in timing. Fixed job stack capacity is not peak RSS or physical KV.
Default: workspace read-only + private temporary writes + network denied; explicit grants only.
